title: Find the organisation, people and API key settings

steps.text: Settings has a section list on the left. Organisation comes first, with the release gate options.
AI provider holds the model key used by Ask FairMind and agent steps.
Team and roles lists members. Owners and admins can invite people and change roles.
Developers is where you create API keys for CI and the CLI.
The audit log lists what happened in the organisation, page by page.
